description: This file implements the internal control server logic for the Rialto media server, including factory creation, control message handling, application state management, and heartbeat handling.

classes.name: ControlServerInternal
classes.description: Implements the internal control server, managing application state, heartbeat, and client communication.

methods.name: ControlServerInternal::ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment messages for heartbeat pings.

methods.name: ControlServerInternal::setApplicationState
methods.description: Updates the application state and notifies the client.

methods.name: ControlServerInternal::ping
methods.description: Sends a heartbeat ping to the client and manages heartbeat handler.

methods.name: ControlServerInternal::registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and sets the application state.
